lessons.title: A Family's Morning
lessons.context: A short story about a family's daily routine.

paragraphs.es: Todos los días, la familia López se despierta a las seis de la mañana.
paragraphs.en: Every day, the López family wakes up at six in the morning.

paragraphs.es: La madre prepara café mientras los niños se visten para la escuela.
paragraphs.en: The mother makes coffee while the children get dressed for school.

paragraphs.es: El padre desayuna rápido porque tiene que llegar temprano al trabajo.
paragraphs.en: The father has breakfast quickly because he has to arrive early at work.

paragraphs.es: A las siete y media, todos salen juntos de la casa.
paragraphs.en: At seven thirty, everyone leaves the house together.

paragraphs.es: Es una rutina simple, pero les gusta empezar el día en familia.
paragraphs.en: It is a simple routine, but they like to start the day as a family.

questions.question: What time does the López family wake up?
What does the mother do?
Why does the father eat breakfast quickly?
options: He has to arrive early at work

questions.question: What do they like about their routine?
options: They start the day as a family

lessons.title: A Trip to the Market
lessons.context: A short story about a Saturday market trip.

paragraphs.es: Cada sábado, Marta va al mercado central con su hija.
paragraphs.en: Every Saturday, Marta goes to the central market with her daughter.

paragraphs.es: Compran frutas frescas, verduras y un poco de pan.
paragraphs.en: They buy fresh fruits, vegetables, and a bit of bread.

paragraphs.es: A su hija le encanta hablar con los vendedores.
paragraphs.en: Her daughter loves talking with the vendors.

paragraphs.es: Uno de los vendedores siempre les regala una fruta extra.
paragraphs.en: One of the vendors always gives them an extra fruit as a gift.

paragraphs.es: Después de comprar todo, caminan a casa disfrutando del sol.
paragraphs.en: After buying everything, they walk home enjoying the sun.

questions.question: When does Marta go to the market?
Who does Marta go with?
What does her daughter love doing?
What does one vendor always do?

lessons.title: My First Job
lessons.context: A short story about a first work experience, told in the past tense.

paragraphs.es: Mi primer trabajo fue en una pequeña cafetería del centro.
paragraphs.en: My first job was at a small café downtown.

paragraphs.es: Trabajaba los fines de semana mientras estudiaba en la universidad.
paragraphs.en: I worked on weekends while I studied at university.

paragraphs.es: Al principio no sabía preparar café, pero aprendí rápido.
paragraphs.en: At first I didn't know how to make coffee, but I learned quickly.

paragraphs.es: Mi jefe era muy paciente y siempre me explicaba todo con calma.
paragraphs.en: My boss was very patient and always explained everything to me calmly.

paragraphs.es: Ese trabajo me enseñó a ser responsable y a hablar con la gente.
paragraphs.en: That job taught me to be responsible and to talk with people.

questions.question: Where was the writer's first job?
When did they work there?
What did the writer not know how to do at first?
What did this job teach the writer?
options: To be responsible and talk with people

lessons.title: A Rainy Day at Home
lessons.context: A short story about spending a rainy day indoors.

paragraphs.es: Ayer llovió todo el día, así que nos quedamos en casa.
paragraphs.en: Yesterday it rained all day, so we stayed home.

paragraphs.es: Preparamos chocolate caliente y vimos una película juntos.
paragraphs.en: We made hot chocolate and watched a movie together.

paragraphs.es: Los niños jugaron juegos de mesa toda la tarde.
paragraphs.en: The children played board games all afternoon.

paragraphs.es: Aunque no pudimos salir, fue un día muy agradable.
paragraphs.en: Although we couldn't go out, it was a very pleasant day.

paragraphs.es: A veces los planes cambian, pero eso no significa que el día sea malo.
paragraphs.en: Sometimes plans change, but that doesn't mean the day is bad.

questions.question: What was the weather like yesterday?
What did they prepare?
What did the children do?
What does the passage say about changing plans?
options: It doesn't mean the day is bad

lessons.title: Planning a Birthday Party
lessons.context: A short story about organizing a celebration.

paragraphs.es: El próximo mes es el cumpleaños de mi madre, y vamos a organizar una fiesta.
paragraphs.en: Next month is my mother's birthday, and we are going to organize a party.

paragraphs.es: Mis hermanos y yo vamos a decorar la casa con globos y flores.
paragraphs.en: My siblings and I are going to decorate the house with balloons and flowers.

paragraphs.es: Vamos a preparar su plato favorito y un pastel de chocolate.
paragraphs.en: We are going to prepare her favorite dish and a chocolate cake.

paragraphs.es: Invitamos a toda la familia y a sus amigas más cercanas.
paragraphs.en: We invited the whole family and her closest friends.

paragraphs.es: Queremos que ese día se sienta muy especial y querida.
paragraphs.en: We want her to feel very special and loved that day.

questions.question: Whose birthday is coming up?
What are they going to decorate the house with?
What are they going to prepare?
options: Her favorite dish and a chocolate cake

questions.question: Who did they invite?
options: The whole family and her closest friends

lessons.title: A Memorable Trip
lessons.context: A short past-tense narrative about a family trip.

paragraphs.es: El año pasado viajamos a la costa por primera vez en familia.
paragraphs.en: Last year we traveled to the coast for the first time as a family.

paragraphs.es: Nos quedamos en un pequeño hotel cerca de la playa.
paragraphs.en: We stayed at a small hotel near the beach.

paragraphs.es: Todos los días caminábamos por la playa antes del desayuno.
paragraphs.en: Every day we walked on the beach before breakfast.

paragraphs.es: Un día vimos delfines nadando muy cerca de la orilla.
paragraphs.en: One day we saw dolphins swimming very close to the shore.

paragraphs.es: Fue un viaje que nunca vamos a olvidar.
paragraphs.en: It was a trip we are never going to forget.

questions.question: Where did the family travel to last year?
Where did they stay?
options: A small hotel near the beach

questions.question: What did they do every day?
options: Walked on the beach before breakfast

questions.question: What did they see one day?

lessons.title: Learning to Cook
lessons.context: A short story about learning a new skill.

paragraphs.es: Hace dos años no sabía cocinar casi nada.
paragraphs.en: Two years ago I hardly knew how to cook anything.

paragraphs.es: Mi abuela me enseñó pacientemente sus recetas favoritas.
paragraphs.en: My grandmother patiently taught me her favorite recipes.

paragraphs.es: Al principio cometía muchos errores, pero seguía practicando.
paragraphs.en: At first I made a lot of mistakes, but I kept practicing.

paragraphs.es: Ahora puedo preparar varios platos que le gustan a toda mi familia.
paragraphs.en: Now I can prepare several dishes that my whole family likes.

paragraphs.es: Cocinar se convirtió en una de mis actividades favoritas.
paragraphs.en: Cooking became one of my favorite activities.

questions.question: How much did the writer know about cooking two years ago?
Who taught the writer to cook?
What did the writer do despite making mistakes?
What did cooking become for the writer?

lessons.title: A Health Scare
lessons.context: A short story about a minor illness and recovery.

paragraphs.es: La semana pasada me sentí muy mal y tenía fiebre alta.
paragraphs.en: Last week I felt very bad and had a high fever.

paragraphs.es: Fui al médico y me dijo que era solo una gripe fuerte.
paragraphs.en: I went to the doctor and he told me it was just a strong flu.

paragraphs.es: Me recetó unos medicamentos y me dijo que descansara mucho.
paragraphs.en: He prescribed some medications for me and told me to rest a lot.

paragraphs.es: Mi familia me cuidó todos los días hasta que mejoré.
paragraphs.en: My family took care of me every day until I got better.

paragraphs.es: Después de una semana, ya me sentía como nuevo.
paragraphs.en: After a week, I already felt like new.

questions.question: How did the writer feel last week?
options: Very bad, with a high fever

questions.question: What did the doctor say it was?
What did the doctor recommend?
Who took care of the writer?

lessons.title: A Lesson from My Grandfather
lessons.context: A short reflective story about wisdom passed down.

paragraphs.es: Cuando era niño, pasaba muchas tardes con mi abuelo en su jardín.
paragraphs.en: When I was a child, I spent many afternoons with my grandfather in his garden.

paragraphs.es: Él me enseñaba sobre las plantas y también sobre la vida.
paragraphs.en: He taught me about plants and also about life.

paragraphs.es: Siempre me decía que la paciencia es la clave de todo.
paragraphs.en: He always told me that patience is the key to everything.

paragraphs.es: Ahora que soy adulto, entiendo mejor sus palabras.
paragraphs.en: Now that I am an adult, I understand his words better.

paragraphs.es: Todavía pienso en él cada vez que trabajo en mi propio jardín.
paragraphs.en: I still think of him every time I work in my own garden.

questions.question: Where did the writer spend time with their grandfather?
What did the grandfather teach besides plants?
What did the grandfather say was the key to everything?
What does the writer do now?

lessons.title: A New Beginning
lessons.context: A capstone story reflecting on change and growth.

paragraphs.es: Hace un año decidí cambiar de trabajo y mudarme a otra ciudad.
paragraphs.en: A year ago I decided to change jobs and move to another city.

paragraphs.es: Al principio tenía miedo porque no conocía a nadie allí.
paragraphs.en: At first I was afraid because I didn't know anyone there.

paragraphs.es: Poco a poco hice nuevos amigos y aprendí a conocer la ciudad.
paragraphs.en: Little by little I made new friends and learned to know the city.

paragraphs.es: Ahora me siento como en casa y estoy muy feliz con mi decisión.
paragraphs.en: Now I feel at home and I am very happy with my decision.

paragraphs.es: Aprendí que a veces los cambios más difíciles traen las mejores sorpresas.
paragraphs.en: I learned that sometimes the most difficult changes bring the best surprises.

questions.question: What did the writer decide to do a year ago?
options: Change jobs and move to another city

questions.question: Why was the writer afraid at first?
What happened little by little?
What did the writer learn?
options: Difficult changes can bring the best surprises
